answer: She launches two hundred labelling agents with no skill at all. The kernel of her plan is to wait for one strong agent's answer on each coral-reef photo and echo it. But every answer arrives as a cipher and is unlocked only after all are submitted. Her agents have to answer blind, so they guess. Scored against the reef surveyors' records, they do no better than dice, and the fable of a skilled crowd dies on the first scoreboard.
